qa_pairs.instruction: What new web service protocols does the Oracle EBS Suite driver support in version 4.1?
qa_pairs.output: In version 4.1, the Oracle EBS Suite driver adds support for REST APIs in addition to the existing SOAP interfaces when configuring the driver object.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you configure the Oracle EBS Suite driver to use REST APIs for user management?
qa_pairs.output: To configure the Oracle EBS Suite driver to use REST APIs, open the driver object configuration and enable the REST option that is now available alongside SOAP. The driver will then communicate with the Oracle EBS Suite through the REST web service endpoints.

qa_pairs.instruction: When configuring the driver object in the Oracle EBS Suite driver version 4.1, which web service interfaces can you select?
qa_pairs.output: While configuring the driver object in the Oracle EBS Suite driver version 4.1, you can select either the REST API interface or the SOAP interface for user management operations.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the new feature introduced in version 4.1 of the Oracle EBS Suite driver.
qa_pairs.output: Version 4.1 of the Oracle EBS Suite driver introduces support for REST web services, allowing the User Management Driver to use REST APIs in addition to the previously supported SOAP protocol when configuring the driver object.
